title: Hard Legendrian unknots
summary: We initiate the study of Reidemeister hardness of Legendrian unknot front projections. Using normal rulings, we obstruct several infinite families of hard unknot diagrams from being drawn with max-tb unknot fronts, along with 1.7 million of the 2.6 million hard unknot diagrams studied in \cite{applebaum2024unknottingnumberhardunknot}. We construct infinitely many smoothly hard max-tb unknot diagrams, and bound their minimum possible writhe. With respect to these bounds, our constructions are conjecturally sharp.
